PortfolioMediaItem.title: PortfolioMediaItem
PortfolioMediaItem.description: Represents an uploaded image or video resource stored in the cloud for the portfolio.

id.description: Unique identifier of the media slot.

key.description: Slot identifier such as hero-cover, project-the-cubo, avatar, etc.

data.description: Data URI, Base64 payload, or external cloud storage URL.

updatedAt.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of last modification.

PortfolioState.title: PortfolioState
PortfolioState.description: Global synchronization state of the portfolio.

lastSyncedAt.description: Timestamp of the last full cloud synchronization.

/portfolio_media/{mediaId}.description: Collection of all customized visual media assets (cover photos, project galleries, videos) synchronized across instances.

/portfolio_state/{stateId}.description: Sync heartbeats and overall state flags for portfolio visitors and owner.
